Change Log

Updates and milestones for the AsterMotion component library.

  1. 08.01.26
    feature

    Library packed and docs adjusted

    AsterMotion is installable via npm, pnpm, and yarn. Adjusted the documentation page to include explanation of props and styling. When variants are available, they are showcased in the following doc.

  2. 07.20.26
    release

    V1 Launch

    V1 launches with the base UI components that are most commonly used throughout the type of work I want to create. V2 is being planned to extend to more components and polishing v1 animations.

  3. 07.22.25
    design

    Figma Design system created

    Branding and philosophies defined in Figma and are now being implemented into code.
